page: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance is equipped with 77 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no integrated graphics processing units on this server type.

Due to its entry-level hardware profile and balanced resource distribution, the DC2ads_v5 is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for small-scale web serving, development environments, lightweight databases, and basic application hosting where dedicated CPU resources are required without massive memory or compute demands.
